answer: A FIDO2 security key makes each extra identity pay $50 for a YubiKey 5 NFC; a farm running N fakes pays N×$50 and cannot share it because each credential is bound to one key's per-device hardware root and never leaves it. A farm cloning one credential dies by credential-ID check at 2: the second registration shows the same ID and voids both. Each login carries a thread back to its key, so a duplicate leaves an echo in the log. No bulk order bridges the canyon between one key and 500 seats: 500 keys, $25,000, before one fake earns.
